hints.content: To find the zeros of the function, we need to solve the equation $f(x)=0$. We can do that by factoring $f(x)$.
There are many ways to find the vertex. We will do it by using the fact that the $x$-coordinate of the vertex is exactly between the two zeros.

In conclusion,

$\begin{align}
\text{smaller }x&=-4
\\\\
\text{larger }x&=14
\end{align}$

The vertex of the parabola is at

$(5,-81)$
